scenarios.name: creates-cadet-and-ignores-nontoken-wizard
scenarios.why: Creates one 2/2 colorless Wizard Soldier creature token named Cadet. The counter clause names Wizard TOKENS only: the nontoken Wizard Prodigal Sorcerer stays a 1/1 with no +1/+1 counter, and the new Cadet itself is not an 'other' Wizard token.

scenarios.name: second-cast-counters-the-earlier-cadet
scenarios.why: Cast again: a second Cadet is created, THEN each OTHER Wizard token gets a +1/+1 counter, so the first Cadet is a 3/3 with one counter and the new Cadet is a 2/2 with none.

scenarios.name: opponent-dealt-noncombat-damage-last-turn-returns-it
scenarios.why: On turn 1 its owner Bolts the opponent (noncombat damage). At the beginning of the next upkeep (the opponent's, turn 2: 'each upkeep'), an opponent was dealt noncombat damage last turn, so the trigger returns Command the Stage from the graveyard to its owner's hand.

scenarios.name: combat-or-self-damage-does-not-return-it
scenarios.why: On turn 1 the opponent is dealt only COMBAT damage (Savannah Lions) and the noncombat damage (Bolt) goes to Command the Stage's own owner, not an opponent. At the opponent's upkeep the intervening-if is false: no trigger, the card stays in the graveyard.
